title: SelectorSwitch
description: Rotary selector with 2 to 5 labelled positions, optionally a key switch (IND-010 .. IND-013).

value.description: Label of the selected position. Empty, or not one of positions: default_position, else the middle position (the Python class resolves it when the widget is created).

positions.description: 2 to 5 distinct position labels, left to right.

keyed.description: Key switch: with locked, the front end cannot move it (IND-012).

locked.description: Key removed: the position is locked for the operator (the host can still set it).

default_position.description: Position the switch returns to from a spring-return position; also the resolved value. Ignored when not one of positions.

spring_return.description: Positions that go back to default_position when the operator releases the switch (IND-013).
